evidence: Added transaction via Description/Amount text input fields; new record appeared in table.
Dashboard page loads showing Total Balance, Monthly Income/Expenses, Net Profit/Loss, charts, and Recent Transactions.
Typing "Adobe" in search box filtered transaction table to only the matching "Software Subscription - Adobe CC" row.
Selecting "Rent" in Category filter combobox filtered table to only the 2 Rent transactions.
Add Transaction dialog created new expense transaction which appeared in the table with correct data.
Edited transaction description via Edit dialog (updated in table), then deleted it via Delete confirmation dialog (removed from table, totals recalculated).
Selected "Utilities" category from Category dropdown when creating transaction; category displayed correctly in table.
Toggled "Tax Related" switch when creating a transaction; created record showed ✓ in Tax column.
Clicking "Add Expense" with all fields empty did not create a record; dialog remained open with no new row added.

issue: Future-dated transactions are accepted without any validation error
actual: Created a transaction dated 2026-12-25 (future relative to current date 2026-09-02); it was accepted and added to the transactions table with no warning or rejection.

evidence: Category filter "Rent" strictly returned only the 2 Rent transactions with matching totals.

issue: No validation preventing/warning about an inverted date range (From later than To)
actual: Set From=2024-12-20 and To=2024-12-01 (start after end); no error/warning was shown, filter silently returned "No transactions found" instead of blocking the invalid input or alerting the user.

evidence: Edit Transaction dialog allowed viewing and adjusting existing transaction fields (description, amount, category, date, tax toggle).
Toggling Tax Related switch immediately reflected "checked" state on the switch/checkbox, and saved record showed ✓ in Tax column.

Created custom category "IX18 Category" (0 transactions initially), then created a transaction "IX18 Test Transaction" ($50) assigned to it. Categories page subsequently showed "IX18 Category" with "1 transactions" and Total $50, confirming custom categories correctly display assigned records.

Clicked "Add Category" on Categories page, created new category "IX18 Category" (Blue, Expense type); it appeared in Expense Categories list with correct name and 0 transactions/$0 total, confirming custom category creation works.

After adding "IX18 Test Transaction" ($50 expense) via Transactions page, navigating to Dashboard (SPA link, no reload) immediately showed it in Recent Transactions and Monthly Expenses updated to $50/Net Profit -$50. After deleting that transaction, Dashboard immediately reverted to Monthly Expenses $0 and Net Profit/Loss $0 with the transaction removed from Recent Transactions — confirming real-time updates on both add and delete without manual refresh.

Reports page (with data present) displayed Total Income/Total Expenses/Net Profit summary cards, a Daily Activity chart, Income by Category and Expenses by Category tables. Tax Summary page (2024, with data) additionally showed full summary tables: Taxable Income by Category, Deductible Expenses by Category (with Amount and % of Total columns), and All Tax-Related Transactions table listing 18 rows with totals — confirming basic financial summary tables are viewable.

issue: Clicking "Print Report" produces no observable/verifiable output
actual: On the Tax Summary page (2024, populated with data), clicked the "Print Report" button. No new browser tab/window opened (confirmed via tab list before/after), no DOM change occurred, and no print dialog or document selection menu appeared in the accessible page tree. There is no observable evidence that a printable report was generated or that any document selection UI appeared.

evidence: Users can view spending/expenditure details in multiple places: Transactions page lists every expense line item with date, description, category, amount; Dashboard shows "Expenses by Category" chart/list; Reports page shows "Expenses by Category" table with per-category totals; Tax Summary page shows "Deductible Expenses by Category" table with Amount and % of Total columns.

issue: Dashboard summary figure does not match actual entered financial data
actual: Dashboard "Total Balance" showed $74,931 ("Across all accounts"), but the Transactions page (source of truth) shows Total Income +$47,592.50 and Total Expenses -$36,585.99, yielding an actual net of $11,006.51 — not $74,931. This is a large, unexplained discrepancy between the Dashboard's headline figure and the actual sum of entered transactions.
